articles.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development

articles.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
articles.description: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
articles.summary: Anthropic, a generative AI company, is going public with a planned cash influx of about $250 million per co-founder. The seven founders will sell an equal number of shares, maintaining control over the company.
points: All seven Anthropic co-founders plan to sell an equal number of shares in the IPO.
Each co-founder expects to receive around $250 million in cash at the IPO' end.

articles.insight: The IPO of Anthropic underscores a significant milestone for generative AI firms as they seek to balance financial gains with maintaining founder influence in a rapidly evolving industry.
